## Change logs

## Commands Changed
- `dev` DevOps commands remove the "Beta" indicator
- `plugin validate` is improved to better handle aliases for command names
- `iam cr-links-usage` and `cr-rules-usage` add longer aliases for better self-documentation

## Other Changes
- Golang version 1.27.1
- IBM Cloud CLI SDK version 1.13.2
- IBM Cloud Dev plug-in version 3.5.8
